_searchUrl: Optional. Lets an ambiguous path hash resolve to its one repeater/room when the other matches are companions or sensors.
_corescopeUrl: Optional. CoreScope's origin, for login and companion linking. Defaults to the origin of resolveUrl.
_nodeNames: For a repeater CoreScope has no name for, asks the repeater itself (ANON_REQ_TYPE_OWNER) and publishes the name on /names. Makes discover replies carry the full pubkey (+24 bytes each).
_uplinkPing: Off unless set. Sends a small message on uplinkChannel and listens for a repeater re-broadcasting it, so CoreScope can map where this companion is heard. Every ping is a flood the region carries; pacing below. uplinkScope is a region name (e.g. "be"); empty uses the companion's own default scope. Needs a free channel slot on the companion.
_regionPacing: Optional. Defaults shown; see src/regionsched.js for why.
